Giant golden stone pestle smashes into earth. Immediate massive bass thud, cracking stone, gritty debris and a short magical golden resonance. Single powerful fantasy RPG ground impact, no buildup, no voice, no music.

One glass potion bottle shatters with a sharp bright glass crack, liquid splash and compact magical elemental pop. Immediate single impact, tight short decay for ten staggered potion explosions. Fantasy RPG, no voice, no music.

Crystal blue magical shield materializes around a hero: soft glass bloom, ascending crystalline shimmer and a gentle resonant protective ring. Immediate onset, compact clean tail. Fantasy RPG sound, no voice or music.
Fantasy alchemist syringe activates: tiny mechanical click, compressed liquid hiss, then a warm energetic rising pulse. Quick crisp invigorating power-up, no heartbeat loop, no voice, no music.

Green healing magic blooms: gentle liquid droplets and sparkling crystal chimes rising softly, warm soothing magical pulse. Immediate soft onset, brief clean decay, fantasy RPG healing spell. No voice, no music.

Instrumental fantasy RPG healing sanctuary background, no vocals, no drums. Soft celesta, harp arpeggios and warm airy strings, peaceful luminous green healing magic, gentle 72 BPM. Begin immediately with a delicate warm consonant chord and flowing sparkle, restrained volume and no dramatic climax. Original brief magical background cue suitable under a healing circle.
